metas.name: Paterson
metas.description:
Captures a routine life as a work of art. One week with a bus driver named Paterson, in Paterson, who writes poems about matchboxes and waterfalls between shifts.

A quiet observation of the triumphs and defeats of daily life, along with the poetry evident in its smallest details.

metas.name: Tampopo
metas.description:
Captures food as craft, sex, comedy and social ritual all at once. A truck driver mentors a widow until her ramen is perfect, cut with vignettes of people eating in every possible way.

A truck driver stops at a small family-run noodle shop and decides to help its fledgling business. The story is intertwined with various vignettes about the relationship of love and food.

metas.name: Do the Right Thing
metas.description:
Captures a neighbourhood on the hottest day of the year. A Brooklyn block and a pizzeria wall of fame, everyone funny and aggrieved in their own direction until the heat does what heat does.

On the hottest day of the year on a street in the Bedford-Stuyvesant section of Brooklyn, everyone's hatred and bigotry smolder and build until violence erupts.

metas.name: Synecdoche, New York
metas.description:
Captures a life trying to represent itself honestly, and drowning in the attempt. A theatre director builds a scale copy of his city inside a warehouse and keeps casting people to play people, including himself, for decades.

A theater director struggles with his work and the women in his life as he creates a life-size replica of New York City inside a warehouse as part of his new play.

metas.name: Grey Gardens
metas.description:
Captures a mother and daughter fused together in a decaying mansion. The Beales, relatives of Jackie Kennedy, singing, bickering and feeding raccoons in the attic — performing for the camera and trapped with each other.

Meet a mother and daughter, high-society dropouts, reclusive cousins of Jackie O., managing to thrive together amid the decay and disorder of their East Hampton, NY, mansion, making for an eerily ramshackle echo of the American Ca...

metas.name: Dr. Strangelove
metas.description:
Captures nuclear annihilation as a bureaucratic procedure. Generals, presidents and advisors in rooms — vain, procedural and insane — while the world ends by checklist.

After a rogue U.S. general orders an unauthorized nuclear attack on the Soviet Union, leaders in the War Room race to prevent global catastrophe.

metas.name: The Death of Stalin
metas.description:
Captures absolute power as petty, terrified men improvising. Stalin drops dead and his inner circle plot, flatter and panic in the same breath — very funny, and people keep being shot between jokes.

Moscow, 1953. After being in power for nearly 30 years, Soviet dictator, Joseph Vissarionovich Stalin, takes ill and quickly dies. Now the members of the Council of Ministers scramble for power.

metas.name: Withnail and I
metas.description:
Captures the end of youth as squalor and one great friendship rotting. Two out-of-work actors in 1969 London, a disastrous country holiday, and one of them beginning to leave the other behind.

Two sloppy actors spend a weekend holiday at an uncle's country cottage.

metas.name: Election
metas.description:
Captures ambition so pure it becomes frightening, at a high school. A student election, a teacher who decides one candidate must be stopped, and everyone's voiceover giving their self-justifying version.

A high school teacher meets his match in an over-achieving student politician.

metas.name: Chungking Express
metas.description:
Captures city loneliness at pop speed. Hong Kong, two lovesick cops, expired pineapple cans, and a snack-bar girl breaking into a man's flat to clean it while 'California Dreamin'' loops.

Two melancholic Hong Kong policemen fall in love: one with a mysterious female underworld figure, the other with a beautiful and ethereal waitress at a late-night restaurant he frequents.

metas.name: Eighth Grade
metas.description:
Captures social anxiety in the age of front-facing cameras, exactly. A girl filming confident advice videos she cannot follow, pool parties endured minute by minute, and a father scene near the end that rearranges parents.

An introverted teenage girl tries to survive the last week of her disastrous eighth grade year before leaving to start high school.

metas.name: The Apartment
metas.description:
Captures loneliness in a big company, and kindness as a decision. An insurance clerk lends his flat to executives for their affairs to get promoted, loves the elevator girl from afar, and hits Christmas at the lowest point of both.

A Manhattan insurance clerk tries to rise in his company by letting its executives use his apartment for trysts, but office politics and his own romantic hopes complicate matters.

metas.name: Amélie
metas.description:
Captures a lonely young woman engineering small happinesses for strangers. Montmartre, a tin of childhood treasures returned to its owner, and a heroine who can fix everyone's life except ask for anything in her own.

Despite being caught in her imaginative world, young waitress Amelie decides to help people find happiness. Her quest to spread joy leads her on a journey during which she finds true love.

metas.name: Singin' in the Rain
metas.description:
Captures pure performed joy, inside a story about an industry panicking. Hollywood switching to sound, a star with a terrible voice, and musical numbers that still feel like showing off for the love of it.

When Hollywood's silent era gives way to talkies, a dashing screen idol and a gifted newcomer navigate romance, rivalry, and the comic chaos of reinventing the movies.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description:
Captures decency as something contagious. A bear framed for stealing the pop-up book he wanted to buy his aunt, sent to prison — and the prison improves because he is in it.

Paddington, now happily settled with the Brown family and a popular member of the local community, picks up a series of odd jobs to buy the perfect present for his Aunt Lucy's 100th birthday, only for the gift to be stolen.

metas.name: Big Night
metas.description:
Captures two brothers arguing about whether a meal should be art or business. Italian immigrants, a failing restaurant, one elaborate dinner to save it, and a final wordless scene of one cooking breakfast for the other.

New Jersey, 1950s. Two brothers run an Italian restaurant. Business is not going well as a rival Italian restaurant is out-competing them. In a final effort to save the restaurant, the brothers plan to put on an evening of incredi...

metas.name: Rushmore
metas.description:
Captures a precocious teenager's grandiosity as a grief strategy. A scholarship kid who runs every club and stages huge plays falls for a widowed teacher and goes to war with a sad industrialist who is, emotionally, the same age.

A teenager at Rushmore Academy falls for a much older teacher and befriends a middle-aged industrialist. Later, he finds out that his love interest and his friend are having an affair, which prompts him to begin a vendetta.

metas.name: Day for Night
metas.description:
Captures a film set as a chaotic temporary family. Truffaut plays the director of a mediocre melodrama, keeping affairs, breakdowns, accidents and deadlines moving toward a finished film nobody thinks is great and everybody needs.

A committed film director struggles to complete his movie while coping with a myriad of crises, personal and professional, among the cast and crew.

metas.name: The Truman Show
metas.description:
Captures a paranoia that turns out to be an accurate description. An insurance salesman in a seaside town so pleasant it feels laminated, a sky that malfunctions, and a dawning suspicion about everyone who loves him.

An insurance salesman begins to suspect that his whole life is actually some sort of reality TV show.

metas.name: Lady Bird
metas.description:
Captures a mother and daughter who love each other in a way that keeps missing. Sacramento, a girl desperate to leave for the East Coast, a mother working double shifts, fights in moving cars, and a final voicemail that reframes every argument.

A fiercely independent teenager tries to make her own way in the world while wanting to get out of her hometown of Sacramento, California, and to get away from her complicated mother and recently-unemployed father.

metas.name: Secretary
metas.description:
Captures kink as, for one specific person, a form of self-knowledge. A young woman fresh out of hospital for self-harm takes a typing job with a demanding lawyer, in a relationship the film treats as tender rather than a diagnosis.

A timid young woman starts working for a demanding lawyer and finds a new way to deal with her self-harming urges.

metas.name: Touki Bouki
metas.description:
Captures two young people dreaming of Paris so hard the film itself starts hallucinating. Senegal: a cowherd and a student steal and scheme toward a ship, on a motorbike with a skull mounted on it, in editing that jumps like a skipping song.

Mory, a cowherd, and Anta, a university student, try to make money in order to go to Paris and leave their boring past behind.

metas.name: Hyenas
metas.description:
Captures a village discovering its price. A woman returns after decades, impossibly rich, offering her poor hometown a fortune for one act of 'justice' against the man who wronged her — while shops fill with goods bought on credit.

A now-rich woman returns to her poor desert hometown to propose a deal to the populace: her fortune, in exchange for the death of the man who years earlier abandoned her and left her with his child.

metas.name: Gummo
metas.description:
Captures boredom and poverty in an American town as unconnected afternoons. Xenia, Ohio, after a tornado: kids sniffing, selling dead cats, taped monologues, no plot arriving to save anyone.

Lonely residents of a tornado-stricken Ohio town wander the deserted landscape trying to fulfill their boring, nihilistic lives.

metas.name: Daisies
metas.description:
Captures two girls deciding the world is spoiled, so they'll be spoiled too. A Czech New Wave food-fight against everything — banquets wrecked, scissors, fire, a chandelier swing — anarchy as pure visual mischief.

After realizing that all world is spoiled, Marie and Marie are committed to be spoiled themselves. They rip off older men, feast in lavish meals and do all kinds of mischief. But what is all this leading to?

metas.name: Playtime
metas.description:
Captures modern architecture failing to be lived in. Tati wanders a Paris of glass and identical cubicles where the jokes happen at the edges of the frame, all at once, none of them underlined.

Monsieur Hulot curiously wanders around a high-tech Paris, paralleling a trip with a group of American tourists. Meanwhile, a nightclub/restaurant prepares its opening night, but it's still under construction.

metas.name: The Long Goodbye
metas.description:
Captures a decent man out of sync with his decade. Altman's Philip Marlowe shuffles through sunlit, corrupt Los Angeles in a rumpled suit, the last person still taking loyalty seriously.

Marlowe investigates a friend's alleged suicide, missing money and murder in 1970s Los Angeles.

metas.name: It's Such a Beautiful Day
metas.description:
Captures a mind coming apart, drawn with stick figures. Hertzfeldt narrates a man with a failing brain in three chapters — funny, fragmented, and by the end genuinely cosmic.

Bill struggles to put together his shattered psyche, in this new feature film version of Don Hertzfeldt's animated short film trilogy.

metas.name: Toni Erdmann
metas.description:
Captures a father trying to joke his daughter back to life. A prankster dad with false teeth infiltrates his consultant daughter's sterile Bucharest existence — a comedy that keeps tipping into grief and back.

A practical joking father tries to reconnect with his hard working daughter by creating an outrageous alter ego and posing as her CEO's life coach.

metas.name: The Favourite
metas.description:
Captures court power as intimate warfare. Two women compete to be Queen Anne's favourite — her bed, her ear, her rabbits — through fisheye candlelit corridors, with a lonely, raging queen at the centre.

In early 18th-century England, the status quo at the court is upset when a new servant arrives and endears herself to a frail Queen Anne.

metas.name: The Worst Person in the World
metas.description:
Captures turning thirty with every option still open and none chosen. Oslo in twelve chapters: a woman cycles through careers and men, including a night that pauses the entire city so she can test a life before living it.

The chronicles of four years in the life of Julie, a young woman who navigates the troubled waters of her love life and struggles to find her career path, leading her to take a realistic look at who she really is.

metas.name: The Banshees of Inisherin
metas.description:
Captures being dumped by a friend. One morning Colm simply doesn't want to talk to Pádraic anymore, and a whole island watches a small rejection escalate toward the mythic. Funny, until the exact moment it isn't.

Two lifelong friends find themselves at an impasse when one abruptly ends their relationship, with alarming consequences for both of them.

metas.name: Crumb
metas.description:
Captures how the same upbringing produces a famous artist, a broken man, and something in between. Cartoonist R. Crumb and his two brothers, all shaped by one brutal household, in Terry Zwigoff's unsparing family portrait.

An intimate portrait of controversial cartoonist Robert Crumb and his traumatized family.

metas.name: American Movie
metas.description:
Captures delusion and genuine talent living in the same person. Mark Borchardt, a Wisconsin sanitation worker with debts and a drinking problem, tries to finish a horror short to fund his dream feature — very funny until, suddenly, it isn't.

Aspiring filmmaker Mark Borchardt attempts to finance his dream project by finally completing Coven (1997), a micro-budget horror film he abandoned years before.

metas.name: Man Bites Dog
metas.director: Rémy Belvaux, André Bonzel, Benoît Poelvoorde
metas.description:
Captures the complicity problem pushed to its logical endpoint — the cluster's one fiction: a student crew follows a charming serial killer for a documentary, graduating from filming him, to holding the camera steady, to helping.

A film crew follows a ruthless thief and heartless killer as he goes about his daily routine. But complications set in when the film crew lose their objectivity and begin lending a hand.

metas.name: Sherman's March
metas.description:
Captures the personal documentary being invented out of failure. McElwee sets out to film Sherman's Civil War campaign, gets dumped before shooting starts, and the film becomes his disastrous search for love among old flames, narrated in a deadpan spiral.

Documentary filmmaker Ross McElwee sets out to make a movie about Union General Sherman's March to the Sea towards the end of the American Civil War, but keeps getting sidetracked by his own love life.

metas.name: Time of the Gypsies
metas.description:
Captures folk storytelling surviving, barely, inside modern crime. A Romani teenager with telekinetic powers is lured into a smuggling life in Italy, half narrated by Goran Bregović's score — Petrović's world taken into magical realism.

In this luminous tale set in the area around Sarajevo and in Italy, Perhan, an engaging young Romany (gypsy) with telekinetic powers, is seduced by the quick-cash world of petty crime, which threatens to destroy him and those he l...

metas.name: Ten Canoes
metas.description:
Captures oral tradition's actual structure. In Arnhem Land, an elder tells a young man a cautionary ancestral tale inside which another tale is told, while they hunt goose eggs in the swamp — stories nested for a practical moral purpose, with jokes.

In Australia's Northern Territory, a man tells us a story of his people and his land. It's about an older man, Minygululu, who has three wives and realizes that his younger brother Dayindi may try to steal away the youngest wife.

metas.name: Amarcord
metas.description:
Captures a community remembering itself, every ritual half affection and half mockery. Fellini rebuilds his hometown of Rimini as permanent carnival: fascist rallies, family dinners, a peacock in the snow, a whole town rowing out to greet an ocean liner.

A series of comedic and nostalgic vignettes set in a 1930s Italian coastal town.

metas.name: Calendar
metas.description:
Captures diaspora as a loop of beautiful images you can't live inside. Egoyan sends a Canadian photographer to Armenia to shoot twelve ancient churches for a calendar, his marriage failing in the car between sites — then the ritual repeats, reframed, back in Toronto.

A woman stays in Armenia after her photographer husband completes his assignment and returns home to Canada.
